population: All individually prefix-valid departure roots of the same four frozen parent games. Include every root even when another root in the same game targets the same cell or is only one turn away.
comparison: Exactly five transitions from each root for parent and the deployed once-per-game option, original prerecorded rival commands held fixed on each transition. Alternate trajectories can contain different units; log unknown opponent orders or extra living opponents for which the tape supplies none. Trace independent real evidence or reasons for stopping.
interpretation: These correlated overlapping counterfactuals were requested after observing the prespecified 0/4 first-root result. They cannot change that result, reopen the native gate, prove strength, or serve as an independent holdout. No new original or final-map games.
